NOTICE OF MOTION TO CONFIRM CONTRACTUAL ARBITRATION AWARD AND TO ENTER JUDGMENT THEREON, PROOF OF SERVICE, POINTS AND AUTHORITIES, DECLARATION FILED BY PETITIONER LAWFINANCE GROUP, INC. HEARING SET FOR JAN-26-2011 AT 09:30 AM IN DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION 301, PETITIONER LAWFINANCE GROUP, INC.'S MOTION TO CONFIRM CONTRACTUAL ARBITRATION AWARD AND TO ENTER JUDGMENT THEREON IS GRANTED. NO OPPOSITION WAS FILED. THE PETITIONER PROVIDED A VALID PROOF OF SERVICE THAT CONFORMS WITH CCP 1013 (A) BY INDICATING THE NAME AND ADDRESS OF THE PERSON SERVED AS IT APPEARS ON THE ENVELOPE IN THE HEARING. ORDER AND JUDGMENT SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PETITIONER LAWFINANCE GROUP, INC. RECOVER FROM RESPONDENT COTTERALL, CHARLES DAVID $59,633.58 PRINCIPAL, $5,500.00 ATTORNEY FEES, $8,856.28 INTEREST, $667.60 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $74,657.46, SEE SCANNED DOC
